Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year comes to 12 times your money; consistently earning 10% a month,
comes to 30 times your money over three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one remarkable feature—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for; discipline is your own. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week”; set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal is given by the market,
while the ability behind the second is yours. The market is open every day; only those who preserve their principal are qualified to keep playing.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What kind of candlestick do you usually FOMO into?
translatedData.subTitle:
The coin’s price shoots up in a huge green candle, everyone in the group is shouting “Buy!”, and you nervously jump in—only to end up
buying at the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Take a good look at that huge green candle that gets your heart racing: it’s what people who are already fully invested want you to chase so they can sell to
Chasing after a sharp, high-volume rally is basically providing liquidity to the holders who got in earlier.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback happens on lower volume and then stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if the price drops right back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you your capital back a second time.

ETH back below 2,400｜Anti-front-running proposal still has payment rules under review｜I’ll wait for confirmation of the setup

I’m leaning cautious, and I wouldn’t chase ETH just because of the words “anti-front-running.” Binance Square’s trending topics still include #ETHDropsBelow2400USDT, and at the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,388—indeed below $2,400. But that tag only describes the price; it doesn’t explain why it fell. What’s more worth examining recently is a technical review in Ethereum’s EIP repository: PR #12539, opened on October 17, discusses how to settle fees for commit–reveal transactions under EIP-8209 when there is no separate payer during the reveal phase. The PR is still Open and awaiting review by the proposal’s author. The official EIP-8209 page is marked Draft, so it would be wrong to say it has already been deployed on mainnet, or that ETH holders have gained protection against sandwich attacks today.

The mechanism isn’t hard to understand: the proposal aims to have users commit to the transaction’s execution details in one block, then reveal and execute them in the next, so front-runners can’t see the full instructions at the earlier stage. But the specification needs to spell out where the fees are deducted from, what happens if a transaction is never revealed, and how execution fees and prepaid deposits fit together. The PR author points out that mechanically applying the existing “invalid if there is no payer” rule from the EIP-8141 it depends on could, taken literally, prevent reveal transactions from passing. They therefore propose paying fees from funds escrowed in the earlier step and restricting fee fields that do not apply. This is a proposal to clarify the specification, not a confirmed mainnet vulnerability. The original EIP also acknowledges costs such as added latency, penalties for failing to reveal, speculative front-running, and tailgating transactions. My view is that the protective effect depends on the final specification, client implementations, audits, and real-world adoption; the proposal’s intended benefits shouldn’t be treated as guaranteed.

Why does this matter for price? If the technology matures in the future, the on-chain transaction experience could improve, but this unmerged wording change won’t automatically create spot demand for ETH. Conversely, with the price currently below $2,400, it’s more important to see whether the market is willing to support it again. Kraken’s rolling 24-hour range was approximately $2,354–$2,427, with the price pulling back from its intraday high. That’s a fact about the market’s reaction, not evidence that the PR caused the price drop. I’m treating $2,400–$2,410 as the first reclaim zone and $2,427 as a further confirmation level. If ETH repeatedly fails to get back above $2,400 on the one-hour chart, the short-term bullish case doesn’t hold for now. If it breaks below $2,354 and fails to reclaim it on a bounce, I’ll abandon the assumption that the range can hold.

机制并不难理解：提案希望用户先把交易执行内容的承诺写入前一个区块，到下一块再揭示并执行，让抢跑者在前一步看不到完整指令。但钱从哪里扣、未揭示如何处理、执行费与预存款怎么衔接，都要在规范里说清。PR作者指出，若机械套用它所依赖的EIP-8141现有“没有付款者则无效”规则，揭示交易按字面可能无法通过，于是提出用前一步托管的费用支付、限制不适用的收费字段。这里是规范澄清提议，不是已被证实的主网漏洞；原EIP也承认延迟、未揭示罚没、猜测性抢跑和尾随交易等代价。我的判断是，保护效果要看最终规范、客户端实现、审计和实际采用，不能把提案目标直接当成确定收益。

为何与价格有关？如果未来技术成熟，链上交易体验可能改善，但这条尚未合并的文案变更不会自动创造ETH现货需求。相反，价格目前低于2400，更应先看市场是否愿意重新承接。Kraken滚动24小时约2354至2427美元，盘中由高处回落；这是行情反应的事实，不是PR导致跌价的因果证据。我把2400至2410当作首道收复区，把2427当作进一步确认位；若一小时多次站不回2400，短线强势判断暂不成立。若向下失守2354且反抽不回，我会推翻“区间仍能守住”的假设。

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#交易心理 #扛单 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Hold a Losing Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? The all-time high, thinking: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Remember, that thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the here and now.

Once you start holding onto a losing trade, you automatically seek out good news and tune out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “what would invalidate the logic behind this trade,”
then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and only then can you see clearly.

Ethereum (ETH) Market Depth Analysis: ETF Outflows Continue, Technicals Enter Extremely Oversold Territory

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of 13:00 on October 18, 2026, Ethereum spot was trading at $2,392.64, extending its recent pattern of weak, range-bound trading. On the hourly chart, the price continued to fall from its opening level of $2,424.83, breaking below the key $2,420 and $2,400 levels in succession. It dipped to a low of $2,383.44 before finding slight support around $2,385. The last five hourly candles have closed lower, with the price continuing to trend down, indicating that sellers are firmly in control.

In terms of trading volume, during the period when the price plunged to around $2,383, trading volume surged to $27.95 million—more than three times the normal level. This suggests heavy panic selling and buying-the-dip activity during the sharp decline. However, the subsequent rebound was weak: the price edged up from $2,385 to just $2,392, a gain of less than 1%, indicating that buyers are currently struggling to mount an effective counterattack. The price has now fallen below the lower Bollinger Band, around $2,385, and is testing the support zone below.

On the daily chart, Ethereum has remained below the 99-period EMA ($2,433), indicating a weak medium-term trend. The 25-period EMA ($2,412) and 7-period EMA ($2,405) have both become resistance levels overhead. The price would need to break through several moving averages in succession to reverse the short-term bearish trend.

2. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving average system shows a clear bearish alignment. The 7-period MA has fallen to $2,410, the 25-period MA to $2,410, and the 99-period MA is at $2,421. The three moving averages have begun to diverge downward, while the price is trading below all of them, confirming a bearish setup. The EMA indicators likewise confirm this trend: the 7-period EMA is $2,405, the 25-period EMA is $2,412, and the 99-period EMA is as high as $2,433. The gap between the price and the long-term average continues to widen.

The MACD indicator continues to weaken. The MACD value has fallen rapidly from -0.96 to -4.46, while the signal line is at -2.98 and the histogram has shifted from a positive 0.16 to -1.47. The MACD is accelerating downward below the zero line, indicating strengthening bearish momentum, with no clear bottoming signal in the short term. The gap between the DIF and DEA is widening, suggesting that the downtrend may continue for some time.

The RSI has moved deep into oversold territory. The 6-period RSI has fallen to 22.19, the 12-period RSI to 33.75, and the 24-period RSI is at 40.23. As with Bitcoin, Ethereum's short-term RSI has also entered technically oversold territory, but its downward momentum is stronger, indicating relatively greater selling pressure on Ethereum. In the KDJ indicator, K has fallen to 31.85, D is at 47.08, and J is just 1.39, nearing the oversold extreme.

The Williams %R (WR) has fallen to -95.94, close to the extreme oversold level of -100. The Stochastic RSI has dropped to 22.52, also in deeply oversold territory. ATR has risen to 13.73, signaling increased volatility. The Supertrend indicator has turned bearish, falling from $2,437 to $2,432 and adding resistance above the price. OBV continues to decline, reaching -776,048, indicating overall net outflows and a lack of confidence among buyers.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum is currently facing a challenging market environment. The main source of pressure is sustained institutional outflows. According to the latest data, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows of $320 million in the week through October 16, exceeding the $228 million in outflows from Bitcoin ETFs over the same period. BlackRock's ETHA fund accounted for about 93% of the outflows, reflecting the reduction of Ethereum positions by large institutional investors. This sustained institutional selling is creating direct selling pressure in the spot market.

Fundamentally, Ethereum faces the challenge of a weakening deflationary mechanism. As Layer 2 networks develop rapidly, more and more transactions are migrating from the mainnet to Layer 2 solutions, leading to a significant decline in mainnet transaction fee revenue. Reduced fee burning means Ethereum's daily issuance now exceeds the amount burned, putting the network back into an inflationary state and weighing on long-term support for the token's value.

On the news front, CZ has publicly voiced support for several digital assets, including XRP, Solana, and Zcash, but did not specifically mention Ethereum, somewhat diverting market attention from ETH. Meanwhile, Solana's Alpenglow upgrade aims to reduce transaction confirmation times to 150 milliseconds, and major Wall Street banks are moving into tokenization, both of which are diluting Ethereum's share of the institutional narrative.

Overall, Ethereum faces significant short-term downside pressure. The $2,380–$2,385 range is the key support zone. If it fails, the next support level may be around $2,350. On the upside, watch resistance at the Bollinger Band middle line at $2,420 and the 99-period EMA at $2,433. Although several oversold indicators suggest that the possibility of a technical rebound is increasing, the rebound may be limited while ETF outflows continue and the fundamental deflationary narrative weakens. 🔥 Vitalik Goes Full Paranoid: New AI Mode Hides Your Prompts, Payments & Identity

Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin just unveiled an experimental “Paranoid Mode” for his personal AI agent — designed to make it much harder for anyone to link your identity, location, or payments to the prompts you send.

Unveiled on October 16, the open-source setup stacks several privacy layers:

Separate Tor circuit for every new conversation

• Cover traffic to mask real requests

• Local LLM prompt rewriting (Vitalik is using a small model like Qwen) that strips identifying details before anything leaves your machine

• zkAPI payments on Ethereum mainnet (accepts ETH & USDC) so the AI provider can’t easily link payments to specific users

The agent also runs inside a sandbox for extra isolation. Vitalik says the system is “getting quite usable,” though it adds noticeable latency, especially when starting new sessions.

Important caveats
This is still experimental. Providers can still see the rewritten prompts, and sophisticated timing analysis or collusion between the AI service and network observers could reduce the protection. It’s not complete anonymity — just a meaningful step toward reducing the data trail AI usage normally leaves.

The move also highlights Ethereum’s growing role in private AI infrastructure. zkAPI itself launched on mainnet earlier this month as a way to pay for metered APIs without revealing identity.

Privacy-focused tooling like this keeps Ethereum relevant in the AI era. Whether it drives short-term price action is another story, but the long-term narrative is clear.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn't an Admission of Failure—It's the Price of Admission for Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to pull the trigger on a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride can't get past it.
Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance, and that small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I've ever seen are the quickest to admit when they're wrong. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

Many people hold $UNI , but still don’t understand how it gets burned! 🦄
Today, let’s explain in plain English exactly how UNI gets burned.

Step 1: Transactions generate fees.
People used to criticize UNI, pointing out that Uniswap had a huge volume of daily transactions, but protocol revenue had little direct connection to the UNI token.
That’s no longer the case. Pools with protocol fees enabled send a portion of their fees to the protocol. The exact rate is set through governance, and it isn’t the same for every pool.

Step 2: Fees go into TokenJar.
You can think of TokenJar as an on-chain fee vault. It can accumulate different assets, such as ETH and stablecoins, but those funds can’t simply be withdrawn at will.

Step 3: To withdraw assets, you first have to burn $UNI ! 🔥
The key here is the Firepit contract.
When the eligible assets in TokenJar are valuable enough, participants have an incentive to trigger the release mechanism: they permanently burn a specified amount of UNI, then withdraw the corresponding assets. If the assets are worth more than the cost of the UNI burned, there’s a chance to profit from the difference.

So the whole process can be summarized as:
User transactions → Protocol collects fees → Assets go into TokenJar → Someone burns UNI in exchange for assets.
Note that this isn’t the project team using funds to buy back UNI on an exchange. Participants are actively carrying out the burn mechanism themselves.

Also, the UNIfication proposal at the end of December 2025 burned 100 million UNI from the treasury in a one-time event. This was a one-off burn and shouldn’t be confused with ongoing burns in the future.
So why is this mechanism worth paying attention to?
Because changes in UNI’s supply are now starting to be linked to protocol fees.

If Uniswap trading continues to grow in the future and eligible fees keep accumulating, the potential scale of burns will also be worth tracking.
Of course, UNI holders won’t directly receive fee dividends as a result, and burns don’t guarantee that the token price will rise.
But I think that in the past, when looking at $UNI , the main things to consider were the ecosystem and market expectations.
Now we can also look at how much the protocol actually collects in fees and how many tokens are really burned.
When the market starts paying serious attention to these figures, could UNI see a new round of valuation discussions?
Don’t just watch the daily candlestick chart. Sometimes the changes really worth studying are hidden in the on-chain mechanics.

content:
很多人持有$UNI ，却还没搞懂它的销毁机制！🦄
今天用大白话讲清楚，UNI到底是怎么被销毁的。

第一步：交易产生手续费。
以前大家吐槽UNI，觉得Uniswap每天都有大量交易，但协议收入和UNI代币没什么直接联系。
现在不一样了。开启协议费用的交易池，会把一部分手续费交给协议。具体比例由治理配置，并不是所有交易池都一样。

第二步：手续费进入TokenJar。
你可以把TokenJar理解成链上的收费仓库。里面可以积累ETH、稳定币等不同资产，但这些钱不能被随便提走。

第三步：想拿走资产，就得先销毁$UNI ！🔥
这里最关键的是Firepit合约。
当TokenJar里符合条件的资产价值足够高时，参与者就有动力调用释放机制：先永久销毁规定数量的UNI，再取出对应资产。如果资产价值高于销毁UNI的成本，就有机会赚取差价。

所以整个流程可以概括成：
用户交易 → 协议收取费用 → 资产进入TokenJar → 有人销毁UNI换取资产。
注意，这不是项目方拿钱去交易所回购UNI，而是参与者主动执行销毁机制。

另外，2025年12月底的UNIfication提案还一次性销毁了金库里的1亿枚UNI。这是一次性销毁，不能和后续持续销毁混为一谈。
那这套机制为什么值得关注？
因为UNI的供应量变化，开始和协议费用联系起来了。

如果未来Uniswap交易持续增长，符合条件的手续费不断累积，潜在销毁规模也值得持续追踪。

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

translatedData.content:
ETH Signature Security Proposal Update | Still a Draft, Not an Upgrade Deployment | I’m Staying Disciplined With My Position

My stance is cautiously neutral: this news is worth monitoring, but not worth chasing just because of the words “quantum-resistant.” An updated draft of EIP-8151 appeared in the Ethereum EIPs repository on October 17. It discusses having ecRecover check account code after signature verification, and explicitly defines failure outputs and the Gas costs for reading an account. The proposal is not about ETH’s price today. It addresses whether, after accounts migrate to new authorization methods in the future, old ECDSA private keys could still be used through certain contract signature entry points. The EIP uses ERC-20 permit as an example. Signature authorization is a fundamental component of wallets, DeFi, and token interactions. Unclear handling of compatibility or fees in one place could have ripple effects across the application layer, so it’s valuable for developers to spell out edge cases now.

It’s important to be clear about the facts: this is a core proposal still marked Draft, and the latest PR is also marked as a draft. Repository discussions and review comments are not an announcement that it has been activated on mainnet, and certainly do not mean that ETH has already completed a “quantum-resistant upgrade.” Reviewers have also pointed out that legacy calls that forward a fixed 3000 Gas could run out of Gas under the proposed rules; compatibility with clients and contracts still needs to be verified. My view is that this kind of security work supports trust among institutions and everyday users over the long term, but it does not mean new buying demand in the short term. The market will focus first on liquidity and risk appetite.

Price action also offers no evidence that the proposal is the sole driver. At the time of writing, ETH/USD was around $2,414.75 on Kraken, with a daily open near $2,399.83 and a rolling 24-hour range of $2,354.01–$2,426.94. ETH is above the daily open, but not far from the top of the range. I view $2,427 as the short-term confirmation level, $2,400 and $2,395 as pullback levels to watch, and $2,354 as a deeper risk boundary. These levels are simply trading conditions based on current public quotes, not predictions that the EIP will push the price to those levels. If the price breaks above $2,427 but quickly falls back, or drops below $2,395 and fails to reclaim it on a rebound, my short-term bullish view is invalidated. If neither price nor volume improves after the news, I’ll stay out of the market rather than treat development progress as a trading signal.

If I were trading this myself: I wouldn’t enter at the moment. I’d only consider a small spot position on the long side, with no high leverage. I’d enter in stages using no more than 3% of my total capital, and only if the 1-hour candle closes above $2,427, a pullback holds $2,420, and volume doesn’t contract significantly. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,460, reduce further at the second target of $2,490, and use a trailing stop around $2,430 to protect the remainder. After entry, I’d use a hard stop if the price falls below $2,395. If it breaks below $2,395 first, I’d cancel the long plan and reassess only after it regains and holds $2,400; I wouldn’t immediately flip and chase a short. If the proposal is explicitly rejected, substantially revised, or delayed by official sources in the future, I’ll reassess the long-term thesis. But no progress on a draft can replace price risk management.

Sources: Ethereum EIP-8151 text, EIPs repository PR #12540及Kraken , public ETH/USD quotes. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH签名安全提案更新｜仍是草案非升级落地｜我先守住仓位纪律

我的态度是偏谨慎的中性：这条消息值得跟踪，但不值得因为“抗量子”三个字追涨。以太坊EIPs仓库10月17日出现EIP-8151的更新草案，讨论让ecRecover在验签后检查账户代码，并明确失败输出与账户读取的Gas计价。提案要解决的不是今天ETH价格，而是未来账户迁移到新的授权方式后，旧ECDSA私钥是否仍可能通过某些合约签名入口继续发挥作用。EIP原文举了ERC-20 permit作为例子。签名授权是钱包、DeFi和代币交互的底层零件，一处兼容性或计费处理不清，影响可能沿应用层扩散，所以开发者现在把边界条件写细有价值。

必须把事实边界说清：这是一项仍标为Draft的核心提案，最新PR也标为草稿；仓库讨论和审查意见不是主网激活公告，更不能推导成ETH已经完成“抗量子升级”。审查者还指出固定转入3000 Gas的旧调用在拟议规则下可能耗尽Gas，相关客户端与合约兼容性仍要验证。我的判断是，这类安全工作长期有利于机构和普通用户建立信任，但短线不等于新增买盘，市场先看流动性和风险偏好。

价格也没有给出单独归因的证据。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2414.75美元，日开约2399.83，滚动24小时区间2354.01—2426.94；ETH站在日开上方，但离区间上沿并不远。我把2427视为短线确认线，2400和2395视为回撤观察带，2354是更深的风险边界。这些价位只是当前公开报价对应的交易条件，不是EIP会推动价格到达的预测。若突破2427后迅速跌回、或者跌破2395且反抽无法收复，短线偏强判断就被推翻；如果消息后价格与成交量都没有改善，我会继续空仓，不把开发进度当交易信号。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与，方向只考虑现货小仓试多，不开高杠杆。只有1小时收盘站上2427、回踩守住2420且量能不明显萎缩，才用总资金最多3%分批入场；第一目标2460减半，第二目标2490再减，余仓用2430附近跟踪保护。入场后跌破2395硬止损；若先下破2395，则取消多头计划，待重新站稳2400再评估，不反手追空。若未来官方明确否决、显著修改或延期提案，我会重新评估长期逻辑；但任何草案进展都不能替代价格风控。

title: ETH 一周跌 4.5%、BTC 只跌 2.4%：9 亿美元清算后，主流币正在悄悄"分层"
subTitle:
过去两周，币圈最容易被忽略、却最值得警惕的一件事，不是比特币又跌了，而是——同样是"主流币"，比特币和以太坊跌得越来越不一样。
看最新数据（截至 10 月 18 日）：BTC 在 8.1 万–8.2 万美元之间窄幅震荡，最新约 8.16 万美元，10 月 12–16 日这一周累计下跌约 2.4%；而 ETH 已经在 2400 美元一线挣扎，最新约 2410 美元，周跌约 4.5%，跌幅几乎是比特币的两倍。
 $BTC 
{future}(BTCUSDT)
把时间拉长，分化更明显。上一周（10 月 5–9 日）ETH 曾单周下挫近 9%，明显跑输 BTC。也就是说，这轮自 8.7 万美元高位回落的调整里，以太坊几乎每一周都比比特币跌得更狠。
更能说明问题的是清算。10 月 15 日市场全线跳水，全网 24 小时清算约 9.35 亿美元，其中多单占 8.6 亿。反直觉的是：以太坊合约未平仓量约 300 亿美元，只有比特币（约 520 亿）的不到六成，但当天 ETH 的清算额（约 2.86 亿）反而高于比特币（约 1.97 亿）。同一天，Solana、XRP、狗狗币等主流币普遍下跌 2%–3%，部分小币种单日跌超 10%，是一次全市场的普跌。
 $ETH 
{future}(ETHUSDT)
为什么会这样？这轮行情其实在给所有只买"主流币"的人上一课：BTC 和 ETH，从来就不是同一种资产。我把这背后的分化，拆成三个看得见的信号。
信号一：ETF 资金正在"区别对待"
本周下跌最直接的推手之一，是机构资金撤离。数据显示，美国现货比特币 ETF 当周净流出约 2.286 亿美元，而以太坊 ETF 净流出约 3.2 亿美元——体量更小的以太坊，反而承受了更大比例的失血。
强于预期的美国经济数据，让市场重新押注美联储把利率维持在高位更久，风险资产整体承压。但在风险偏好收缩时，机构往往先砍"弹性更大、确定性更低"的仓位，这就是 ETH 资金流出更猛的原因。ETF 申赎数据是每天都能看的"聪明钱"风向标：连续净流出时，别急着去抄弹性标的。
信号二：以太坊的多头，比想象中更拥挤
清算数据暴露了一个反直觉的事实：跌得越多的资产，往往不是因为利空最多，而是因为多头最拥挤。
ETH 用不到比特币六成的未平仓合约，却贡献了更高的清算额，意味着大量以太坊多单带着更高的杠杆、更集中的止损位。一旦价格向下击穿关键支撑（比如这次的 2400 美元），连环强平会让跌幅自我强化。反观比特币，持仓更厚、杠杆相对温和，下跌时也更"钝"。
信号三：这轮是"宏观行情"，BTC 更像压舱石，ETH 更像成长股
这轮回调的源头不在加密行业内部，而在宏观：美债收益率走高、美元走强、加息预期反复。在这种环境里，比特币越来越被当作"数字黄金"、宏观贝塔相对更低的压舱石；而以太坊由于生态叙事、链上收入和更高 beta，更接近一只高弹性的成长资产。
风险偏好扩张时，成长股（ETH）涨得猛；风险偏好收缩时，它也跌得狠。这不是以太坊"基本面崩了"，而是两类资产在不同周期里的正常分工。
那么，普通投资者该怎么安排主流币仓位？
第一，放弃"主流币买哪个都一样"的错觉。比特币是你仓位里的压舱石，以太坊是博取周期弹性的进攻仓，两者的仓位、止损和持有周期应当不同，而不是简单各买一半。
第二，把 ETF 资金流和清算数据当成"情绪温度计"。ETF 连续净流出、多头清算还没出清时，控制仓位、留足子弹，比猜底更重要；只有当资金回流、杠杆出清，反弹才更有质量。
第三，8 万美元是眼下比特币的心理与技术双重关口，本周盘中已多次试探、一度逼近。在有效站稳之前，我更倾向分批、定投、低杠杆，而不是在 8 万附近一次性打满。真正的方向选择，最终还要看美联储的政策信号、以及 ETF 资金能否重新转正。
主流币行情，正在从"鸡犬升天"的贝塔阶段，进入"拼基本面、拼资金"的分层阶段。这对愿意研究的人，其实是好事——潮水退去时，你才看得清谁在裸泳，也才买得到便宜的好资产。
你现在更看好比特币守住 8 万后的修复，还是在等以太坊超跌反弹？评论区聊聊你的主流币配置思路。

风险提示：本文仅为个人经验与公开信息分享，不构成任何投资建议。加密资产波动剧烈，合约与杠杆可能导致本金全部损失，请根据自身风险承受能力独立决策，DYOR。

The market was quiet over the weekend, but opinions were sharply divided: some opened an initial long position in SanDisk at 1220, betting on a rebound Monday; others stayed completely out, waiting for the trend to reveal itself. Which side are you on?

First, the facts: SanDisk slid steadily to around 1215, Ethereum kept falling along with it, and Bitcoin couldn’t hold up either. Such a sharp drop suggests three things are happening:

① Deleveraging isn’t over yet. Rapid declines are often accompanied by cascading liquidations—long positions get forcibly closed → triggering more selling → setting off the next wave of liquidations. Until this negative feedback loop runs its course, any “buying the dip” is like trying to catch a falling knife. The signals to watch are simple: funding rates turn positive and liquidation volume shrinks. That’s when things are finally settling down.

② The drivers vary completely by asset, so don’t lump them together:
Stocks like SanDisk: driven by spot NAND prices, manufacturers’ capacity strategies, AI server capital expenditure expectations, and profit-taking around earnings. Semiconductors are high-beta; if the Nasdaq flinches, they can fall three times as much.
Ethereum: watch ETF flows, on-chain staking and unlock-related selling pressure, and ecosystem activity. At its core, it’s still a beta asset—if Bitcoin can’t stabilize, it’s hard for Ethereum to form an independent bottom.
Bitcoin: a macro-priced asset. The US Dollar Index, Treasury yields, and the Fed’s interest-rate path matter more than any on-chain indicator. ETF net inflows and outflows are also the most tangible marginal buying and selling pressure right now.

③ “Down a lot” doesn’t mean “at the bottom.” A bottom forms when signals come together: declining volume, extreme fear indicators, smart money flowing back in, and a shift in macro expectations. Missing even one could mean this is just a pause before another leg down. Have these signals been confirmed yet? At least, I haven’t seen them.

So the smart move isn’t to guess the bottom; it’s to wait for confirmation: let a new trend emerge, then enter after a pullback holds. Paying a few extra points in cost buys you greater certainty.

Three scenarios for Monday: a higher open and catch-up rally (weekend news is positive and shorts cover); a lower open and further decline (macro data or ETF outflows worsen); or a higher open followed by a choppy retreat (the most grueling scenario, with neither bulls nor bears winning). Personally, I’m not betting on direction—position sizing matters more than opinions.

How do you think Monday will go? Leave your view and reasoning in the comments, and let’s see how it plays out at the open.

周末盘面很安静，但分歧很大：有人 1220 建了闪迪的头仓多单，赌周一反弹；也有人干脆空仓，等趋势自己走出来。你站哪边？
先摆事实：闪迪一路阴跌到 1215 附近，以太坊跟跌不止，比特币也没扛住。跌得这么急，说明三件事正在发生：

① 去杠杆还没结束。 快速下跌通常伴随连环爆仓——多头仓位被强平→砸出更多卖盘→触发下一批强平。这种负反馈不跑完，任何"抄底"都是在接飞刀。判断信号很简单：资金费率转正、爆仓量萎缩，才算消停。

② 分资产看，驱动因素完全不同，别混为一谈：
闪迪这类存储股：跟的是 NAND 现货价、原厂产能策略、AI 服务器资本开支预期，外加财报窗口的获利了结。半导体高 beta，纳指一哆嗦它跌三倍。
以太坊：看 ETF 资金流向、链上质押与解锁抛压、生态活跃度，本质上还是贝塔资产——大饼不走稳，它很难独立见底。
比特币：宏观定价资产。美元指数、美债收益率、美联储的利率路径，比任何链上指标都管用；再加上 ETF 的净流入流出，是当前最实的边际买盘/卖盘。

③ "跌得多"不等于"跌到底"。 底部是信号凑出来的：缩量、恐慌指标极端、聪明钱回流、宏观预期转向——缺一个都可能是中继。现在这些信号确认了吗？至少我没看到。
所以聪明的做法不是猜底，是等右侧：新趋势走出来、回踩不破，再开仓。成本多几个点，换的是确定性。

content:
一、以太坊当前价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月十八日，以太坊现货价格报两千四百一十七点八五美元，过去二十四小时微跌约百分之零点三六。从小时级别K线来看，ETH在亚洲时段早盘一度冲高至两千四百二十九美元附近，随后逐步回落，目前在两千四百一十四美元至两千四百二十美元区间内窄幅整理。当前价格运行在布林带中轨上方，上轨位于两千四百三十二美元，中轨位于两千四百一十二美元，下轨位于两千三百九十二美元，带宽收窄至约四十美元，显示市场正在酝酿方向性突破。

从均线系统来看，七周期均线报两千四百一十五美元，二十五周期均线报两千四百一十三美元，九十九周期均线报两千四百二十四美元。短期均线与中期均线基本粘合，而长期均线位于价格上方形成压制。指数移动平均线方面，七周期EMA报两千四百一十六美元，二十五周期EMA报两千四百一十六美元，两者几乎重合，表明市场处于关键的多空平衡点。价格需要有效突破两千四百三十五美元的九十九周期EMA才能打开上行空间。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标方面，DIFF线报负一点二一，信号线报负二点七一，柱状图报一点四九。MACD柱状图连续四个周期保持正值，且从零点上方的零点八八逐步扩大至一点四九，显示多头动能正在缓慢积累。RSI指标方面，六周期RSI报四十九点一四，十二周期RSI报四十九点二零，二十四周期RSI报四十八点一三。三条RSI线均运行在五十附近的中性区域，既未超买也未超卖，暗示市场等待新的催化剂来打破平衡。

KDJ指标显示K线报五十点三二，D线报五十七点六五，J线报三十五点六六。J线快速下行至低位区域，短线存在超卖反弹的可能。威廉指标报负三十九点五四，较此前的负七点大幅回落，说明短线卖压有所增强。ATR十四周期报十二点一三，波动率持续走低，市场进入低波蓄势阶段。综合指标来看，ETH的多空信号比为九比六，复合指标给出做多信号，整体胜率达百分之八十一，平均最大收益率为百分之零点四八，技术面略偏多头。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的基本面环境较为复杂。积极方面，以太坊联合创始人维塔利克发布了名为偏执模式的AI隐私工具，旨在保护用户的金融查询和投资数据不被模型运营方追踪，这一举措引发了市场对AI与区块链隐私交叉领域的广泛关注。德意志银行等机构持续推进加密托管服务，为以太坊的机构级需求提供了基础设施保障。链上隐私应用迎来新一波发展浪潮，七款新的隐私应用正在降低用户使用门槛。

然而，以太坊也面临不容忽视的压力。现货ETF持续遭遇赎回，周度净流出约三点二亿美元，形成持续的卖盘压力。二层网络的快速发展导致主网Gas费用持续低迷，ETH的销毁量不足以覆盖新增发行量，通缩代币经济学模型受到一定程度的削弱。此外，纳斯达克上周的大幅回调对ETH形成联动压力，此前ETH曾在两千三百五十六美元附近遭遇清算。综合来看，ETH短期在两千四百美元关口进行多空拉锯，建议关注两千四百三十五美元的阻力位和两千三百九十美元的支撑位，等待方向选择结果。

【Sunday Market Recap | BTC holds $80K, ETH gets wicked, BNB trades sideways near $720】

I thought the weekend would be quiet, but then another wick appeared in the early hours. Here’s a rundown of today’s market action—just a record, not financial advice.

1. BTC: The $80K level is still holding
BTC traded mostly between $81,300 and $81,900 today, with an intraday low near $80,900. It hasn’t decisively broken below $80K. Looking back over the past week: it closed above $83,000 on the 13th, dipped to around $79,700 intraday on the 15th before bouncing back, and has since moved sideways between $81,000 and $82,000.

Flows are weak: on the 16th, U.S. spot BTC ETFs saw net outflows of about $82.4 million, while ETH ETFs had net outflows of about $69.7 million on the same day. BTC’s market dominance is around 59%–60%. Money still seems more willing to stay in BTC, putting altcoins under pressure.

2. ETH: That early-morning wick
ETH plunged in the early hours today. On-chain analyst Ember monitored a whale who had previously opened a long position worth about $187 million. The whale had 4,890 ETH (about $11.74 million) liquidated near $2,356, right at the low of this latest decline. ETH is now hovering around $2,400, with a 24-hour range of roughly $2,364–$2,438.

Another familiar face, “Machi Big Brother,” was liquidated once again on Hyperliquid, wiping out almost all the money he had just deposited. Leverage can teach even seasoned traders a lesson.

3. BNB: Trading in a narrow range
BNB moved in a narrow range of $711–$723 today and is now near $720. It was still above $790 at the start of the month, so the pullback over the past two weeks has been significant. Today’s intraday range was only around ten dollars, a clear contraction in volatility.

4. External factors: U.S. tech stocks are the biggest variable
Last week, the Nasdaq 100 fell 5.5% for the week, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped about 16% over eight trading days, and Brent crude briefly hit $110 a barrel. Over the weekend, tokenized shares of companies like Micron and SanDisk on-chain were also hit by large sell orders, triggering 1%–5% wicks and a wave of liquidations. Before U.S. stocks open on Monday, crypto could well remain at the mercy of sentiment around tech stocks.

5. A few things I’m watching
1. $80K is a level both bulls and bears are watching; where the weekly candle closes matters a lot;
2. While ETFs continue to see outflows, don’t expect altcoins to rally independently;
3. Weekend liquidity is thin, so wicks are more likely, and high-leverage contracts are especially prone to getting liquidated;
4. Right now, it’s more suitable to do your research and plan spot positions than to bet on a direction with leverage.

Do you think $80K can hold this week? Share your take in the comments 👇

content:
【周日复盘｜大饼守 8 万，以太被插针，BNB 720 附近横盘】

周末本来以为能安静一下，结果凌晨又是一根针。把今天的盘面捋一遍，纯记录，不构成任何建议。

一、BTC：8 万这条线还在
今天 BTC 基本在 81,300–81,900 美元之间磨，日内低点在 80,900 附近，没有有效跌破 8 万。往回看一周：13 号收在 83,000 上方，15 号盘中下探到 79,700 附近又被拉回来，之后就一直在 81,000–82,000 横着。
资金面偏弱：16 号美国现货 BTC ETF 净流出约 8,240 万美元，ETH ETF 同日净流出约 6,970 万美元。BTC 市值占比在 59%–60% 左右，钱还是更愿意待在大饼里，山寨承压。

二、ETH：凌晨那根针
今天凌晨 ETH 急跌，链上分析师 Ember 监测到，一位之前开了约 1.87 亿美元多单的巨鲸，有 4,890 枚 ETH（约 1,174 万美元）在 2,356 美元附近被清算，刚好是这轮下跌的最低点。现在 ETH 在 2,400 上下，24 小时区间大概 2,364–2,438。
另一个老熟人“麻吉大哥”在 Hyperliquid 上又一次被清算，新存进去的钱基本归零。杠杆这东西，老手也一样会被教育。

三、BNB：窄幅横盘
BNB 今天在 711–723 美元之间窄幅震荡，现在 720 附近。月初还在 790 上方，两周下来回调不小，今天的日内波动只有十来美元，波动明显收窄。

四、外部环境：美股科技是最大变量
上周纳指 100 单周跌 5.5%，费城半导体指数 8 个交易日跌了约 16%，布油一度到 110 美元。周末链上的美光、闪迪这些股票代币也被大单砸出 1%–5% 的插针，带出一波清算。周一美股开盘前，币圈很可能继续被科技股情绪牵着走。

五、我的几个观察
1. 8 万是多空都在盯的位置，周线收在哪里很关键；
2. ETF 连续流出期间，别指望山寨独立行情；
3. 周末流动性差，插针概率高，高倍合约最容易被收割；
4. 现在更适合做功课、做现货规划，而不是拿杠杆去赌方向。

你觉得这周 8 万能守住吗？评论区说说你的判断👇

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Your Position: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Rolling your position” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, roll it over a few times,
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let's talk about what those stories leave out.

【What rolling a position involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you treat them as risk capital for a new position and keep opening trades,
It's essentially using the market's money to trade with leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be incredible; when the trend stops, those unrealized gains can go from
dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of rolling profits is “being right repeatedly.” If you have a 60% win rate each time, the odds of getting four wins in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramiding: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going in heavy right away and adding until you’re fully loaded with unrealized profits is a fast track to the liquidation list.
It’s a familiar sight. The right approach is called pyramiding.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
Once the move is confirmed, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position gets, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, then adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses, and once your nerves give way, your whole strategy falls apart.

title: Крипторынок: что важно отслеживать сейчас
subTitle:
Оценивать рынок только по росту одной монеты опасно. Более надёжная картина складывается из нескольких сигналов: динамики BTC и ETH, ширины движения альткоинов, торгового оборота и реакции цены на ключевые уровни.

Если большинство ликвидных пар снижается, отдельный сильный рост ещё не означает полноценного разворота. Если падение замедляется, число растущих пар постепенно увеличивается, а цена удерживает поддержку при устойчивом объёме, это может говорить о стабилизации. Но подтверждение требует повторных наблюдений — одного зелёного свечного импульса недостаточно.

На что смотреть:
• BTC и ETH — направление рынка и способность удерживать локальные уровни.
• Ширина рынка — сколько пар растёт и сколько продолжает снижаться.
• Объём — подтверждает ли он движение или импульс быстро затухает.
• Волатильность и ликвидность — резкие движения могут сопровождаться ложными пробоями.
• Управление риском — заранее определённый уровень отмены сценария важнее попытки угадать дно.

Вывод: не стоит путать краткосрочный отскок с подтверждённым разворотом. Лучше дождаться нескольких согласованных сигналов и оценивать рынок по свежим данным, а не по эмоциям и громким заголовкам.

Материал носит информационный характер и не является инвестиционной рекомендацией. Проверяйте котировки и риски самостоятельно.

DeepSeek-V4 officially launches, adding Pro and Flash versions to its API

Over the past two years, DeepSeek has maintained a rapid pace of model releases: V3 launched in late 2024, R1 followed in early 2025, and a series of upgrades—including V3.1 and V3.2—came afterward. In February 2026, some users got an early look through an app update at a gradual rollout that expanded the context window from 128K to 1M, with the knowledge base updated through May 2025. On April 24, the official changelog confirmed the formal launch of DeepSeek-V4.
The official changelog shows that the API now supports two new versions, V4-Pro and V4-Flash, and is compatible with both the OpenAI ChatCompletions API and the Anthropic API. The endpoint remains unchanged; developers only need to set the model parameter to deepseek-v4-pro or deepseek-v4-flash. The old model names deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner will be discontinued on July 24, 2026. During the transition period, they will respectively point to V4-Flash’s non-thinking mode and thinking mode. A June report from a third-party cloud platform also said that the production version of V4 introduced a 1M-token context window and a new sparse attention architecture.
A closer look at this update suggests a clear emphasis on efficiency rather than parameter-count showmanship. A previous Nomura Securities report said that two design features introduced in V4—mHC manifold-constrained hyper-connections and the Engram conditional memory module—address two major pain points: instability in deep-network training and high memory usage. The former makes information flow between layers more stable, while the latter places static knowledge in inexpensive memory, freeing up costly HBM. The firm believes V4’s core value lies in using architectural innovations to lower training and inference costs and advance the commercialization of AI applications—not in upending the existing AI value chain. Nor does it expect V4 to recreate the panic over computing demand seen when V3 launched. Notably, the report also mentioned that DeepSeek models accounted for more than half of calls to open-source models on OpenRouter in late 2024, but their share had fallen significantly by the second half of 2025. V4 faces a much more complex competitive environment than it did a year ago.
The impact on crypto markets can only be assessed through logical inference for now; the available evidence contains no data on how related sectors actually responded after V4’s release. There are three possible transmission channels. First, if inference costs fall substantially, the demand narrative for decentralized computing projects could be reassessed, echoing the institutional view that the release will not trigger panic over computing demand. Second, low-cost long-context capabilities could benefit AI agent development: multi-step tasks consume more tokens, potentially providing a catalyst for the agent narrative. Third, as open-source models continue to approach the performance of closed-source models, expectations for local deployment and decentralized inference may strengthen. These are all projections, not established facts.
Editor's note: The clearest signal in this update is the deliberate effort to keep migration costs low. Compatibility with both APIs, combined with a three-month transition period for the old model names, shows that the official priority is the developer ecosystem. For the crypto industry, the ultimate beneficiaries of improved model efficiency are more likely to be application-layer projects that generate real usage and on-chain settlement demand, rather than assets linked to AI only by association. Two sets of data are worth tracking: migration activity after the old model names are discontinued on July 24, and actual changes in application-level usage.

#DeepSeek发布更新版AI模型 #BTC #ETH #BNB

content:
DeepSeek-V4正式发布，API新增Pro与Flash双版本

过去两年，DeepSeek保持了极高频率的模型迭代：2024年底上线V3，2025年初推出R1，随后又有V3.1、V3.2等系列升级。2026年2月，部分用户在App更新中率先体验到上下文从128K扩展至1M的灰度版本，该版本知识库同步更新至2025年5月；4月24日，官方更新日志确认DeepSeek-V4正式上线。
官方日志显示，API现已支持V4-Pro与V4-Flash两个新版本，同时兼容OpenAI ChatCompletions接口与Anthropic接口，接入地址保持不变，开发者只需把模型参数改为deepseek-v4-pro或deepseek-v4-flash。旧的deepseek-chat与deepseek-reasoner两个模型名将于2026年7月24日停止使用，过渡期内分别指向V4-Flash的非思考模式与思考模式。另据第三方云平台6月的报道，正式版V4带来了1M token上下文与新的稀疏注意力架构。
拆解这轮更新，重心明显偏向效率而非参数炫技。野村证券此前报告称，V4引入的mHC流形约束超连接与Engram条件记忆模块两项设计，分别应对深层网络训练不稳定与显存占用两大痛点：前者让层间信息流动更稳定，后者把静态知识放进廉价内存，释放昂贵的HBM显存。该机构认为，V4的核心价值在于以底层架构创新压低训练与推理成本、推动AI应用商业化，而非颠覆现有AI价值链，也不会重现当年V3发布时的算力需求恐慌。值得注意的是，报告同时提到2024年底DeepSeek模型曾占OpenRouter开源模型调用量的一半以上，到2025年下半年份额已明显回落，V4面对的竞争环境远比一年前复杂。
对加密市场的影响，目前只能做逻辑推演，证据中并无V4发布后相关板块的实际反应数据。可能的三条传导路径：其一，推理成本若实质性下降，去中心化算力类项目的需求叙事面临重估，这与机构关于不会引发算力恐慌的判断相互呼应；其二，低成本的长上下文能力利好AI智能体开发，多步骤任务会消耗更多Token，Agent相关叙事有望获得催化；其三，开源模型性能持续逼近闭源，可能强化本地化部署与去中心化推理的需求预期。以上均为推演，不是已发生的事实。
编辑观察：本轮更新最清晰的信号是迁移成本被刻意压低——双接口兼容叠加三个月旧名称过渡期，说明官方把开发者生态放在首位。对加密行业而言，模型效能提升的最终受益者，更可能是真正产生调用消耗与链上结算需求的应用层项目，而非仅靠概念关联的标的。后续值得跟踪两组数据：7月24日旧模型名停用后的迁移情况，以及应用端调用量的实际变化。

ETH Slides Toward $2,345 | Transaction Expiry Mechanism Still Being Refined in Proposal Discussions | I’m Staying Flat for Now

My stance is to wait and see, and to keep “developer discussions” separate from “mainnet catalysts.” Neither Binance Square’s trending topics nor Most Searched shows a new trending topic directly related to ETH, so I won’t force a connection. Ethereum’s official EIPs repository is discussing compatibility between EIP-8266 and EIP-8250 in PR #12538: the former explores time-limited transaction nonces, while the latter explores more flexible nonce keys. The author notes that if both drafts were adopted as currently worded, their “expiry mode” encodings could conflict, and has therefore proposed selection rules and a way to identify pending transactions. Developers are still openly exploring the edge cases.

The potential significance is better wallet experiences and more reliable transactions: if the proposal matures, users and applications may eventually have more control over handling expired orders and parallel pending transactions. But the PR is still Open, and both EIPs are drafts. This does not mean the feature is already on mainnet, much less that ETH is about to see greater demand or lower gas fees. The Foundation’s October 16 announcement states that Glamsterdam is planned for activation on the Hoodi testnet on October 26, while the mainnet date remains undecided. The testnet timeline should not be conflated with the drafts above as though they were part of a confirmed upgrade package.

At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken is around $2,345.36, with a daily open of $2,399.83 and a rolling 24-hour high and low of approximately $2,426.94 and $2,326.25, respectively. The price is near the bottom of the range. The pullback is reflected in actual prices, but it cannot be said to have been caused by this PR. There is no new regular ETF trading session over the weekend, and the latest entry on Farside is still October 16; old data should not be treated as current selling pressure. Long-term improvements to the project and short-term price pressure can coexist.

For key levels, I’m watching the rolling low near $2,326 as support, $2,400 as a psychological level and confirmation zone near the daily open, and around $2,427 as the rolling high for this period. If ETH first recovers $2,400 and holds it on a retest, that would suggest selling pressure may be easing. If rebounds are repeatedly capped at $2,400, I’d still view them as weak bounces. A break below $2,326 followed by a sustained failure to recover it would invalidate my short-term stabilization thesis. Even if a long lower wick appears afterward, I’d wait for trading to move back above the level rather than trying to call the bottom during a sharp drop.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now; I’d stay flat for the time being, keeping open only a conditional spot-long setup. I’d consider opening a position with 2% of total capital only after the price holds above $2,400 for at least an hour and then successfully retests and holds near $2,390. I would never use high leverage. The first target is $2,427, where I’d close half the position; the second target is $2,470, where I’d close most of the remainder. The initial stop-loss would be below $2,370. If slippage would push the expected loss beyond my plan, I wouldn’t enter. After entry, if the price falls back below $2,390 and cannot quickly recover it, I’d proactively reduce the position; if the stop is hit, I’d close it entirely. If $2,326 breaks first, this long setup is invalidated, and I’d stay flat and reassess. I did not trade according to this plan today, and I am not claiming any returns.

Sources: Ethereum’s official EIPs PR #12538 and the original EIP-8266 and EIP-8250 texts; Ethereum Foundation’s Hoodi announcement; Kraken ETH/USD; Farside ETH fund table. #ETH
The above is for personal market commentary only and does not constitute investment advice.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: ETF Outflows and Oversold Signals Coexist

October 18, 2026

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of the early hours of October 19 Beijing time, the spot price of Ethereum stood at $2,345.61, down approximately 2.08% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly chart, ETH traded in a narrow range between $2,365 and $2,380 during the Asian and European sessions. After the U.S. session began, it saw a sharp drop, touching a low of $2,329 before recovering slightly and stabilizing near $2,338. Overall, its performance was notably weaker than Bitcoin’s, indicating that Ethereum is currently facing more severe selling pressure.

In its recent price action, Ethereum has fallen below the support of several key moving averages. The 7-period moving average at $2,362, the 25-period moving average at $2,397, and the 99-period moving average at $2,416 are all above the current price, forming successive layers of resistance. The price is trading near the lower Bollinger Band at $2,342, substantially below the middle band at $2,396. Such a rapid decline is often accompanied by short-term oversold conditions, but it also reflects the strength of bearish momentum.

The main reason for Ethereum’s continued weakness is large-scale ETF outflows. Data show that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows of approximately $320 million last week. BlackRock’s ETHA fund alone saw $299 million in outflows over the week, accounting for the vast majority. Ongoing ETF redemptions directly reduce buying pressure in the market while fueling anxiety among holders, creating a negative feedback loop.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

On the 1-hour chart, the MACD indicator shows accelerating bearish momentum. The MACD line is at -17.49, the signal line at -10.62, and the histogram has widened to -6.87, indicating that downward momentum is still unfolding. Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum’s bearish MACD signal is stronger, reflecting a greater need for a correction.

As for the RSI, RSI6 has fallen to 13.21, RSI12 is at 22.66, and RSI24 is at 31.92. RSI6 has entered deeply oversold territory; historically, readings below 15 have often coincided with short-term rebound triggers. On the KDJ indicator, K is at 12.96, D at 18.79, and J at 1.31. Although all remain at low levels, the J line has started to turn upward, potentially signaling that a short-term oversold rebound is approaching.

The moving averages are in a fully bearish alignment: EMA7 is at 2,362, EMA25 at 2,391, and EMA99 at 2,425, with the price well below all of them. The lower Bollinger Band at 2,342 has been touched, while ATR14 is at 15.86, indicating increased volatility. The Williams %R (WR) is at -90.31, also in deeply oversold territory. Overall, although Ethereum’s short-term technical outlook is bearish, extreme oversold readings across several indicators suggest that the likelihood of a rebound is rising.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Market sentiment toward Ethereum is currently rather pessimistic. Persistent, large-scale ETF outflows are the most direct bearish factor, reflecting a lack of confidence among institutional investors in Ethereum’s near-term prospects. The validator exit queue is roughly balanced with deposits, which means more staked ETH could be unlocked and enter circulation in the future, adding pressure on the supply side.

From a fundamental perspective, activity in the Ethereum ecosystem is increasingly migrating to Layer 2. While this lowers costs for users, it also reduces gas fees on the mainnet, weakening the effect of EIP-1559’s burn mechanism and diminishing ETH’s deflationary characteristics. This has had some impact on the confidence of long-term holders.

On the positive side, the RWA market on Solana grew by 600% in one year, from $700 million to $4.3 billion, and the tokenization trend across the broader crypto ecosystem continues to accelerate. Major Wall Street banks, including Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, and Morgan Stanley, are actively expanding into tokenization, while DTCC has officially launched tokenization services supporting 25 asset classes. These developments are positive for the crypto industry as a whole, including the Ethereum ecosystem, over the long term.

Overall, Ethereum remains in a short-term correction channel, with $2,300 serving as a key psychological support level. Given that RSI6 has entered deeply oversold territory, a technical rebound could occur at any time. However, if ETF outflows persist, the rebound may be limited. Investors are advised to watch the strength of support in the $2,300–$2,350 range and monitor changes in ETF fund flows.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people just getting started ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U of your own capital and use 10x leverage, you’re actually controlling
a 1,000U position. If the price rises 1%, your capital gains 10% (relative to your own capital); conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss of your capital—note, the loss is calculated based on the total position you borrowed to control.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves about 10% against you, your capital is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact point also depends on the margin ratio).

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% on wins and losing 50% on losses. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in each time, here’s the long-term math: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
That looks like a positive expected value. But consider the path: two losses in a row means a 75% loss, and you’d need a 300% gain just to break even.
A positive expected value strategy + going all-in = a high probability of ruin. This is the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out in crypto
every day.

With the same strategy, but using only 20% of your capital each time: two losses in a row = -18%, barely a dent,
while you still capture the long-term expected value. The strategy hasn’t changed—only your position size. The outcome can be life or death.

subTitle:
本金几百上千U的朋友最焦虑：这么点钱怎么翻身？先说结论：小资金的
优势恰恰是「船小好调头」，别拿大资金的打法硬套。

【三个建议】1. 合约杠杆别超过5倍，小本金最大的敌人是归零，不是
赚得慢；2. 把80%精力从「找百倍币」挪到「练执行」——同样是练手，
拿小仓位在BTC/ETH上练，比在小币上练生存率高得多（至少不容易
被一根针带走）；3. 每月有结余就补点本金，本金曲线平滑上升，比
赌一次大的靠谱一百倍。

扎心但真实的话：小资金翻身的案例存在，但它们的共同点不是杠杆
高，是那位玩家在亏完之前已经练出了纪律。

translatedData.subTitle:
The script for every market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt phase: Prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone’s shouting, “Sell the rally!”
② Acceptance phase: Prices hit a new high, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors cautiously jump in.
③ Excitement phase: Prices keep surging, people in the group chat start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria phase: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is skyrocketing.
⑤ Denial phase: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy pullback—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic phase: Prices plunge day after day, and everyone is capitulating—but this is where the seeds of the next cycle are planted.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Is a Blockchain’s Fuel Cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay Gas fees to transfer tokens or mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The essence】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who execute computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more everyone rushes to execute transactions, and the higher the gas price (Gas unit price).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → on-chain transactions surge → Gas fees skyrocket. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they choose late-night hours or quiet market periods for on-chain operations. The same operation can cost half as much.

#萨尔瓦多比特币持仓突破7800枚  The sideways action after 1 a.m. is the most honest kind: what you think is “no action” is both bulls and bears waiting for the other side to blink first—and then charging you fees on both sides for good measure.

Who’s most likely to get rekt today?
BTC at 81,166, down just 0.056% over 24h, but it’s slapped traders around twice between 82,295 and 80,819.
ETH has it the worst: 2,371, down 1.32% over 24h. It just hit a ceiling at 2,430 yesterday, and more than a percentage point evaporated in five hours.
SOL at 102.41 is stuck on the roller coaster between 101.25 and 104.79; BNB at 712.82, down 0.08% over 24h, is flatlining like it didn’t even show up to work.
So: the bagholders who chased ETH at 2,430 are writing tragic tales of being underwater, and the top-of-the-mountain guards have finally found their people; leveraged longs got an involuntary checkup on that -0.35% 15m candle; and sidelined traders who missed the rally are the most comfortable of all—after all, their FOMO hasn’t been cashed in yet.
Funding rate: +0.0038%—the longs are still paying the shorts. Classic “I’m not bearish, I’m just taking your money.”

Sideways markets are the exchange’s money printer: bulls and bears beat each other up, the exchange skims its cut, and two groups of Paper Hands keep passing each other the knife.
Diamond Hands aren’t about holding for a long time; they’re about knowing why you’re holding. The position is yours, not borrowed.
BTC’s 15m volume has shrunk from 122 coins to 15. This isn’t a reversal coming—it’s nobody willing to catch the falling knife.
The air is already thin at the top, and leverage won’t even let you bring an oxygen tank.
The saddest are the people who just emerged from Rug Pull PTSD, finally worked up the courage to hit Buy, only to find out they’d bought more air.

Are you going to keep being Diamond Hands, or admit you just can’t bring yourself to cut a losing position?
Are you sticking with the idea that this is a shakeout, or admitting it’s the exchange’s annual checkup for leveraged traders?

#BTC  #ETH

ETH and AI Payments Experiment | Real Code, but Not Production-Ready | Stay Disciplined Near $2,372

My stance is to observe rather than chase the rally. A Binance news account mentioned that “paranoid mode,” involving Vitalik, aims to separate AI requests, identity, and payments. I went back and checked the public code documentation for zkAPI under the Ethereum organization: the project is a collaboration between Open Anonymity and the Ethereum Foundation. It is designed to let users deposit ETH, pay per request, and withdraw their remaining balance. The server can verify the ability to pay, but should not be able to identify which on-chain deposit funded a payment. The client development branch also adds Tor session isolation, prompt rewriting, and cover traffic. This is an experiment in payments and privacy—not an Ethereum protocol upgrade, nor evidence that all AI services have integrated it.

The most important caveat is buried in the same documentation: the current branch is not a production version, some network lists have not been deployed, and the production proving keys are also missing. The proving parameters in the development environment cannot be treated as a security guarantee for large-scale commercial use. The news shows that developers are experimenting with ETH as a settlement asset for machine calls, but it does not prove how many additional on-chain fees, actual paying users, or sustained buying demand have resulted today. Even if applications adopt it in the future, we would need to look at deployed availability, independent audits, paid request volume, and net settlement amounts—in that order. If any of these are missing, translating the “AI narrative” directly into an ETH valuation is premature. Privacy is not absolute, either: service providers may still see rewritten requests, and traffic timing could also reveal information.

The market reaction calls for similar restraint. ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,372, weaker than the day’s opening price of about $2,400, with a rolling 24-hour range of $2,354 to $2,427. This price action only indicates that the market has not yet made a confirmed, sustained break higher on the news; it does not mean the decline was caused by zkAPI. First, watch whether $2,400 can be reclaimed and held, then $2,427. The short-term line of defense is $2,354. If the price moves back above $2,400 and holds there, the bearish view would begin to ease. If it breaks below $2,354 and then fails to reclaim it on a bounce, the idea of short-term stabilization would be invalidated. 美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
USDT is indispensable for trading futures, but many people haven’t stopped to think about what gives it its $1 value.

【How it works】A stablecoin is managed by its issuer: you give it $1, and it issues 1 USDT to you, then puts
dollars (and equivalent assets) into its reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can go to the issuer
to redeem them. This “mint-and-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price near $1.
The price occasionally deviates slightly (for example, to $0.999), but arbitrageurs quickly step in to close the gap.

Ethereum’s decline has been significantly steeper than Bitcoin’s, mainly due to outflows from ETFs. Ethereum spot ETFs saw approximately $320 million in outflows this week, exceeding the outflows from Bitcoin ETFs. In addition, U.S. September CPI data came in higher than expected, further intensifying selling pressure on risk assets. As a high-beta asset, ETH has been hit particularly hard.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

In terms of moving averages, the current price has fallen below the 7-period moving average ($2,389), the 25-period moving average ($2,405), and the 99-period moving average ($2,418), forming a clear bearish alignment. Exponential moving averages likewise confirm the bearish trend: EMA7 is at $2,385, EMA25 at $2,403, and EMA99 at $2,429. The gap between the price and the long-term moving average is widening.

The Bollinger Bands show an upper band at $2,438, a middle band at $2,404, and a lower band at $2,369. The current price has fallen below the lower Bollinger Band, signaling a clearly oversold condition. As for MACD, the MACD line is at -10.66, the signal line at -6.11, and the histogram at -4.55. Bearish momentum continues to build, with the histogram widening consecutively, indicating that the downtrend may not yet be over.

The RSI indicators show that the 6-period RSI is 27.16, deep in oversold territory; the 12-period RSI is 32.88; and the 24-period RSI is 38.57. For the KDJ indicator, K is 20.29, D is 30.45, and J is -0.03, all reflecting extreme oversold conditions. The Williams %R indicator is -83.80, also confirming an oversold market. Notably, although technical indicators point to extreme oversold conditions, the combined indicator signal remains bullish: 12 of 15 factors are giving bullish signals, accounting for as much as 80%. This suggests that medium- to long-term bullish strength remains substantial, and the current decline may be driven more by short-term sentiment.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum is currently facing multiple headwinds. First, ETF funds continue to flow out, with outflows reaching $320 million this week and negative net inflows recorded for several consecutive days. Institutional investors’ retreat has placed sustained pressure on the price. Second, gas consumption on the mainnet has declined. As activity shifts to Layer 2, the deflationary burn mechanism on Ethereum’s mainnet has become less effective, somewhat weakening its support for ETH’s value.

Among the latest market developments, Vitalik released an AI privacy tool called “Paranoid Mode,” designed to prevent sensitive financial data from being leaked to centralized AI model providers. The move has drawn institutional attention to the intersection of AI and blockchain security. Solana’s RWA market has grown by more than 600% over the past year, expanding from $700 million to $4.3 billion, challenging Ethereum’s competitiveness in the RWA sector.

Despite the many short-term headwinds, Ethereum’s technical indicators show that it is extremely oversold, while bullish signals account for as much as 80% of the factor analysis, with an overall win rate of approximately 66%. For medium- to long-term investors, the current price may be an area worth watching for potential positioning. Closely monitor the strength of support around $2,360 and changes in ETF fund flows.

以太坊市场分析：空头占优，关注超卖反弹机会

一、价格走势分析

截至2026年10月18日，以太坊现货价格报2366.37美元，过去24小时下跌约1.0%。从近5个小时的K线数据来看，ETH从2418美元的高位持续走低至2372美元附近，整体呈现明显的下行趋势。日内最高触及2418美元，最低下探至2361美元，价格波动区间约57美元。

以太坊的跌幅明显大于比特币，这主要受到ETF资金流出的拖累。本周以太坊现货ETF流出约3.2亿美元，甚至超过了比特币ETF的流出规模。此外，美国9月CPI数据高于预期，进一步加剧了市场对风险资产的抛售压力，ETH作为高贝塔资产受到的冲击更为显著。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，当前价格已全面跌破7周期均线（2389美元）、25周期均线（2405美元）和99周期均线（2418美元），空头排列格局清晰。指数移动平均线同样确认空头趋势，EMA7报2385美元，EMA25报2403美元，EMA99报2429美元，价格与长期均线之间的偏离度正在扩大。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于2438美元，中轨位于2404美元，下轨位于2369美元。当前价格已跌破布林带下轨，属于明显的超卖信号。MACD指标方面，MACD线报负10.66，信号线报负6.11，柱状图为负4.55，空头动能持续扩张，且柱状图连续扩大，表明下跌趋势尚未结束。

RSI指标显示，6周期RSI为27.16，已深入超卖区域；12周期RSI为32.88；24周期RSI为38.57。KDJ指标中K值为20.29，D值为30.45，J值为负0.03，均处于极度超卖状态。威廉指标WR报负83.80，同样确认超卖。值得注意的是，虽然技术面极度超卖，但综合指标信号仍显示为看多，15个因子中有12个发出看多信号，占比高达80%，这说明中长期多头力量仍然较强，当前的下跌可能更多是短期情绪驱动。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临多重压力。首先是ETF资金持续外流，本周流出规模达3.2亿美元，连续多日录得负净流入，机构投资者的离场对价格形成了持续压制。其次是主网Gas消耗下降，随着活动向Layer 2迁移，以太坊主网的通缩燃烧机制效果减弱，这对ETH的价值支撑产生了一定影响。

从市场热点来看，Vitalik发布了名为"偏执模式"的AI隐私工具，旨在防止敏感金融数据泄露给中心化AI模型提供商，这一举措引发了机构对AI与区块链安全交叉领域的关注。Solana的RWA市场在过去一年增长了600%以上，从7亿美元增长到43亿美元，这对以太坊在RWA赛道的竞争力构成了挑战。

尽管短期面临诸多不利因素，但以太坊的技术指标已显示极度超卖，且因子分析中多头信号占比高达80%，综合胜率约66%。对于中长期投资者而言，当前价位可能是一个值得关注的布局区域。建议密切关注2360美元附近的支撑力度，以及ETF资金流向的变化。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Out Is a Position Too—and It's the One Seasoned Traders Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you're not holding a position, you're not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings whittle away their capital.

In reality, staying out is the only position with zero losses. If you don't understand the market, stay out.
When bulls and bears are battling, stay out. After several losing trades in a row, stay out. The money you save in these three situations
will be more than most traders make.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but the principle holds true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital ready, and when an opportunity comes, you'll have ammunition. Hold on to your bullets.

translatedData.content:
Over the past 4 hours, Binance futures liquidations totaled about $21.85 million, with long positions accounting for 93.7% ($20.48 million in longs / $1.37 million in shorts). The largest liquidation was $ETH .

Let’s use this figure to talk about liquidations.

The liquidation data Binance pushes is a snapshot: each trading pair can receive at most one update per second, so the actual liquidation volume is often higher.

The often-mentioned “long squeeze” refers to falling prices triggering liquidations of long positions, with the resulting sell orders pushing prices down further. A “short squeeze” is the opposite: rising prices trigger liquidations of short positions, and covering those positions pushes prices even higher.

Working backward from where you’d place your stop-loss to determine position size is much more reliable than choosing a position size on a whim.

#ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (your execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses
The same kinds of mistakes keep showing up in your trade log—for example, immediately reversing your position after a stop-loss,
or failing to let winning trades run.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

ETH around $2,390 | Three-day ETF net outflows of $259.5 million | Watch $2,400 for a rebound

My stance is to watch cautiously and not call the weekend price recovery a return of institutional inflows. Farside’s fund-by-fund table shows net outflows from U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs of $129.5 million, $60.3 million, and $69.7 million on October 14, 15, and 16, respectively, for a three-day total of about $259.5 million. The entire outflow on the 16th came from ETHA, according to the table. This is why it is important to check the fund-by-fund details rather than misstate the aggregate figure as every fund seeing outflows at the same time. More importantly, it is the weekend, and the table’s latest entry is still for the 16th; end-of-day flows for the new trading day on the 19th are not yet available. The circulating claim that “fund flows have already shifted on Monday” is not a fact confirmed by this table.

The way these fund-flow figures affect ETH is through marginal buying pressure and expectations—not because a single net-outflow figure automatically means there is immediate spot selling. ETF creations and redemptions involve market makers, inventory, and timing differences, while prices are also influenced by perpetual-futures liquidations, the dollar, and overall risk appetite. After several consecutive days of negative flows, I care more about whether flows stabilize on the next trading day than about using old data to predict the next hourly candle. Binance Square’s trending topics still include Grayscale and three crypto funds from Republic, but those are private products for eligible investors and should not be conflated with the U.S. spot ETH ETF flow table. I won’t jump on that tag in this piece.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, the latest ETH/USD price on Kraken was around $2,390, with an intraday open of about $2,399.83 and a rolling range of $2,326.25–$2,426.94. The price has rebounded from its low but remains slightly below the day’s open. This is a snapshot of USD spot trading on one exchange, not a Binance ETH/USDT quote, and it does not prove that ETF inflows drove the rise. First, watch whether price can reclaim and hold $2,400, then the rolling high near $2,427. On the downside, watch the $2,360 area; a drop below $2,326 that is not quickly recovered would invalidate the short-term recovery thesis. If ETFs still see significant net outflows on the next U.S. trading day, be wary of a false breakout even if price briefly moves above $2,400.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. I’d only consider a small spot long after confirmation, with my current position at 0% and no leverage. I would only use up to 2% of my total capital for a test position if ETH/USD first closes above $2,400 on the one-hour chart, holds that level on a retest, and the broader market does not simultaneously lose its recent lows. The initial target would be $2,427; I’d sell half there and let the rest run toward $2,460, without assuming it will necessarily get there. If price falls back toward $2,360 after entry, I’d follow my plan and close the position at a stop-loss rather than add to it on the way down. I’d also proactively close any remaining position that has not hit its stop if ETF data worsens on Monday or ETH closes below $2,400 again on the one-hour chart. If no trigger occurs, I’ll remain flat. Missing part of a rebound is more manageable than abandoning risk discipline.

Data sources: Farside’s fund-by-fund Ethereum ETF flow table and publicly available Kraken ETH/USD market data. Fund flows are historical end-of-day figures; market data is a snapshot from the time of writing. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH约2390美元｜三日ETF净流出2.595亿美元｜反弹先看2400

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把周末的价格修复直接叫作机构资金回流。Farside逐只基金表显示，美国现货以太坊ETF在10月14日、15日、16日分别净流出1.295亿、6030万、6970万美元，三日合计约2.595亿美元。16日这笔流出在表中全部来自ETHA；这说明应看逐只明细，不能把汇总数字误写成每只基金同时撤退。更重要的是，今天是周末，表格最近一行仍为16日，尚无19日新交易日的日终流量。现在流传的“周一资金已转向”并非这张表已经确认的事实。

这类资金数据影响ETH的机制是边际买盘和预期，而不是一条净流出记录自动等于当下现货抛盘。ETF申赎涉及做市、库存与时差，价格还受永续合约清算、美元和整体风险偏好牵动。我更在意连续数日负值后，下一交易日能否止住，而不是拿旧数据预测下一根小时线。币安广场热榜仍有灰度与Republic三款加密基金的话题，但那是面向合资格投资者的私募产品，不能与美国ETH现货ETF资金表混为一谈；这一篇不蹭该标签。

市场已经如何反应？写稿时Kraken的ETH/USD最新约2390美元，日内开盘约2399.83美元、滚动区间2326.25—2426.94美元。价格从低位回升，却仍略低于日开；这是交易所美元现货的一次快照，不是币安ETH/USDT报价，也不能证明上涨由ETF申购推动。上方先看2400能否重新站稳，再看2427附近的滚动高位；下方先看2360一带，真正使短线修复判断失效的是跌回2326以下且无法迅速收回。若下一个美股交易日ETF仍明显净流出，即使价格短暂越过2400，也要防假突破。

subTitle:

U.S. President Donald Trump has waived significant provisions of the Graham Act, suspending new tariffs on Russian goods and on major buyers of Russian energy shortly before the law's implementation deadline. The move has triggered immediate backlash from Democratic lawmakers and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who condemned the decision as "wrong" and detrimental to Ukraine's efforts to counter Russia's ongoing invasion.
#BNB #WTC 

The Graham Act, designed to tighten economic pressure on Moscow, would have imposed fresh tariffs targeting both Russian exports and countries purchasing substantial volumes of Russian energy. By invoking the waiver, the administration has paused these measures, effectively delaying one of the most sweeping sanctions packages enacted in recent years.
#ETH 

Zelenskyy's rebuke was blunt, framing the waiver as a signal of weakening resolve at a critical moment in the war. Critics argue that any relaxation of pressure offers Russia breathing room to sustain its military campaign and undermines the international coalition built around sanctions.

The decision follows a recent temporary easing of sanctions on Russian diesel exports, a step that had already raised concerns among allies and analysts about the direction of U.S. policy. Observers now warn that the waiver could open the door to further sanctions relief, potentially eroding the cumulative economic pressure that Western governments have assembled since the invasion began.

Supporters of the administration's approach have not publicly detailed the rationale behind the timing, leaving questions about what, if anything, Washington expects in return. For Kyiv and its backers in Congress, the concern is clear: each concession risks being read in Moscow as an opening, and the waiver arrives at a moment when unity among Ukraine's partners is already being tested.
#GOLD #criyptocrouncey 

The episode underscores a broader debate over how far economic leverage should be pushed—and whether flexibility on sanctions strengthens or weakens the hand of those seeking to end the war on acceptable terms.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, making it suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, that’s evidence I was wrong.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.title: Funding rates reveal long-short sentiment: learn to read three typical scenarios
translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we’ll talk about how to use them as a sentiment gauge.

[State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive] This means longs are overcrowded, with everyone borrowing to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp drop caused by a long squeeze could happen at any moment. That doesn’t mean you should immediately
short, but rather: be extra cautious about going long at this stage and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates remain negative] Shorts are overcrowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to flee has already fled, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past began at times like these.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is
a payment exchanged between longs and shorts. The exchange only collects and distributes it; it doesn’t make money from it.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no expiration date. So how does their price stay in line with the spot price? It’s all thanks to the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.
